Xatu

Psychic Flying

Johto · Generation 2

Xatu is a Psychic/Flying-type Mystic Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 1.5 m tall and weighs 15 kg. It evolves from Natu. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (95), with a base stat total of 470.
